_comment: Copy this file to config/applyKit.json (the installer does it for you) and replace every EDIT ME. applyKit.json is private and never committed. Summaries are keyed by the track names in config/profile.json.

profile.label: School
profile.value: EDIT ME: school, degree, graduation date

summaries.finance: EDIT ME: 2-3 sentence pitch for this kind of role.
summaries.operations: EDIT ME: 2-3 sentence pitch for this kind of role.
summaries.ai_training: EDIT ME: 2-3 sentence pitch for this kind of role.
summaries.startup: EDIT ME: 2-3 sentence pitch for startup generalist roles.

_emailTemplate_help: Used when a job applies by email. {role}, {company}, {name} and {links} (every link in profile) are filled in; {summary} is your summary for that job's track.
_eligibility_help: Used to hide jobs you cannot take. workIn: countries you can work in without a visa. tnEligible: Canadian/Mexican citizens can often use a TN visa for US business roles. graduation: YYYY-MM. maxYearsExperience: more than this is flagged, 3 more is hidden.
